data.gender_notes: Aithan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Aithon', meaning 'fire'. In Greek mythology, Aithon was a mountain god. In Christianity, Aithan may symbolize the divine spark within us, or the fiery passion for our faith. The name Aithan carries the meaning “Fire, God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aithan usually hope their child will grow to embody fire, god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine fire within.
data.etymology: Aithan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fire, God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aithan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
